answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is proof of stake-weighted reputation with a bonded deposit. Each agent must lock collateral before its attestations count, and that bond gets slashed if its grades are later found to contradict an honest majority. A harbor of trusted peers judges new entrants slowly, so spinning up a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Like a crystal lattice, the structure holds because every node is tied to others, and a single atlas of verified identities can be checked by anyone.
